hints.tr: `for name in grades:` ile gez; `grade = grades[name]`. Not henüz yoksa `by_grade[grade] = []`, ardından `by_grade[grade].append(name)`.
hints.en: Walk with `for name in grades:`; `grade = grades[name]`. If the grade is not there yet, `by_grade[grade] = []`, then `by_grade[grade].append(name)`.

hints.tr: Yazdırırken `for grade in sorted(by_grade):` notları alfabetik sırada verir; `print(grade + ":", by_grade[grade])`.
hints.en: When printing, `for grade in sorted(by_grade):` gives the grades in alphabetical order; `print(grade + ":", by_grade[grade])`.

hint.en: Walk through the students with a loop.
